entries.title: II Kings 10:1
segments: ¶Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote and sent letters to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to those who reared Ahab's [sons], saying:

entries.title: II Kings 10:2
segments: Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master's sons [are] with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and weapons,

entries.title: II Kings 10:3
segments: choose the best qualified of your master's sons, set [him] on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.

entries.title: II Kings 10:4
segments: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, "Look, two kings could not stand up to him; how then can we stand?"

entries.title: II Kings 10:5
segments: And he who [was] in charge of the house, and he who [was] in charge of the city, the elders also, and those who reared [the sons], sent to Jehu, saying, "We [are]  your servants, we will do all you tell us; but we will not make anyone king. Do [what is] good in your sight."

entries.title: II Kings 10:6
segments: Then he wrote a second letter to them, saying: If you [are] for me and will obey my voice, take the heads of the men, your master's sons, and come to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow. Now the king's sons, seventy persons, [were] with the great men of the city, [who] were rearing them.

entries.title: II Kings 10:7
segments: So it was, when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons and slaughtered seventy persons, put their heads in baskets and sent [them] to him at Jezreel.

entries.title: II Kings 10:8
segments: Then a messenger came and told him, saying, "They have brought the heads of the king's sons." And he said, "Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning."

entries.title: II Kings 10:9
segments: So it was, in the morning, that he went out and stood, and said to all the people, "You [are] righteous. Indeed I conspired against my master and killed him; but who killed all these?

entries.title: II Kings 10:10
segments: "Know now that nothing shall fall to the earth of the word of the LORD which the LORD spoke concerning the house of Ahab; for the LORD has done what He spoke by His servant Elijah."

entries.title: II Kings 10:11
segments: So Jehu killed all who remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men and his close acquaintances and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

entries.title: II Kings 10:12
segments: And he arose and departed and went to Samaria. On the way, at Beth Eked of the Shepherds,

entries.title: II Kings 10:13
segments: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, "Who [are] you?" So they answered, "We [are] the brothers of Ahaziah; we have come down to greet the sons of the king and the sons of the queen mother."

entries.title: II Kings 10:14
segments: And he said, "Take them alive!" So they took them alive, and killed them at the well of Beth Eked, forty-two men; and he left none of them.

entries.title: II Kings 10:15
segments: ¶Now when he departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab, [coming] to meet him; and he greeted him and said to him, "Is your heart right, as my heart [is] toward your heart?" And Jehonadab answered, "It is." [Jehu said], "If it is, give [me] your hand." So he gave [him] his hand, and he took him up to him into the chariot.

entries.title: II Kings 10:16
segments: Then he said, "Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD." So they had him ride in his chariot.

entries.title: II Kings 10:17
segments: And when he came to Samaria, he killed all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed them, according to the word of the LORD which He spoke to Elijah.

entries.title: II Kings 10:18
segments: Then Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, "Ahab served Baal a little, Jehu will serve him much.

entries.title: II Kings 10:19
segments: "Now therefore, call to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. Let no one be missing, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is missing shall not live." But Jehu acted deceptively, with the intent of destroying the worshipers of Baal.

entries.title: II Kings 10:20
segments: And Jehu said, "Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal." So they proclaimed [it].

entries.title: II Kings 10:21
segments: Then Jehu sent throughout all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left who did not come. So they came into the temple of Baal, and the temple of Baal was full from one end to the other.

entries.title: II Kings 10:22
segments: And he said to the one in charge of the wardrobe, "Bring out vestments for all the worshipers of Baal." So he brought out vestments for them.

entries.title: II Kings 10:23
segments: Then Jehu and Jehonadab the son of Rechab went into the temple of Baal, and said to the worshipers of Baal, "Search and see that no servants of the LORD are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal."

entries.title: II Kings 10:24
segments: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men on the outside, and had said, "[If] any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escapes, [whoever lets him escape, it shall be] his life for the life of the other."

entries.title: II Kings 10:25
segments: Now it happened, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, "Go in [and] kill them; let no one come out!" And they killed them with the edge of the sword; then the guards and the officers threw [them] out, and went into the inner room of the temple of Baal.

entries.title: II Kings 10:26
segments: And they brought the [sacred] pillars out of the temple of Baal and burned them.

entries.title: II Kings 10:27
segments: Then they broke down the [sacred] pillar of Baal, and tore down the temple of Baal and made it a refuse dump to this day.

entries.title: II Kings 10:28
segments: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal from Israel.

entries.title: II Kings 10:29
segments: ¶However Jehu did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin, [that is], from the golden calves that [were] at Bethel and Dan.

entries.title: II Kings 10:30
segments: And the LORD said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in doing [what is] right in My sight, [and] have done to the house of Ahab all that [was] in My heart, your sons shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth [generation]."

entries.title: II Kings 10:31
segments: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart; for he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam, who had made Israel sin.

entries.title: II Kings 10:32
segments: In those days the LORD began to cut off [parts] of Israel; and Hazael conquered them in all the territory of Israel

entries.title: II Kings 10:33
segments: from the Jordan eastward: all the land of Gilead-Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh-from Aroer, which [is] by the River Arnon, including Gilead and Bashan.

entries.title: II Kings 10:34
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, all that he did, and all his might, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.title: II Kings 10:35
segments: So Jehu rested with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria. Then Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.

entries.title: II Kings 10:36
segments: And the period that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria [was] twenty-eight years.
